extracted.intended_audience: general Wikipedia readers and editors (people researching or editing this biography)
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic Wikipedia article about a living public figure (biography page) describing life, career, views, controversies, awards, and citations; intended both for readers and for editors maintaining Wikipedia policy and style standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articles lacking reliable references
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This category tag indicates the article needs addition of reliable, verifiable sources for statements; editors should add citations to reputable published sources to support claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articles with dead external links
rubrics_metrics.description: All articles with dead external links / Articles with permanently dead external links
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fix or replace dead external links (use archived versions where appropriate) to ensure references and external links remain accessible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wikipedia indefinitely semi-protected biographies of living people
rubrics_metrics.description: Wikipedia indefinitely semi-protected biographies of living people
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page is semi-protected due to biography-of-living-person (BLP) concerns; additions and edits should follow BLP policy with extra care for sourcing and neutrality, and may be restricted to established editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use American English
rubrics_metrics.description: Use American English from October 2019 / All Wikipedia articles written in American English
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article text should use American English spelling and conventions consistently (e.g., 'color' not 'colour').

rubrics_metrics.name: Use mdy dates
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dates in the article should follow the month-day-year (mdy) format in accordance with the specified variety of English for the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short description consistency with Wikidata
rubrics_metrics.description: Short description is different from Wikidata
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article's short description should be checked and, if necessary, aligned with the Wikidata short description to avoid conflicting summaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articles containing potentially dated statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles containing potentially dated statements / All articles containing potentially dated statements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements that are time-sensitive should be qualified, dated, or updated; flag/remove wording that will become misleading as time passes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official website not in Wikidata
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add the subject's official website to the linked Wikidata item so the article and metadata include an authoritative official link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pages using infobox person with deprecated parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Pages using infobox person with deprecated parameters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Update the article's infobox to remove or replace deprecated parameters according to current infobox_person/module documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include authority control identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Authority control databases / International identifiers (ISNI, VIAF, GND, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide authority control identifiers in the article's metadata to aid library/catalog integration and disambiguation (ISNI, VIAF, GND, LCCN, WorldCat, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Articles with short description
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the short description is concise, accurate, and follows Wikipedia's short description guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance of living-person content and neutrality
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit BLP and neutrality requirements visible in category and content (e.g., controversial claims, allegations, health issues, legal cases)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Biographies of living persons must avoid unsourced or poorly sourced contentious material, present controversies neutrally, and rely on high-quality, reliable sources for negative or medical claims.
